title: Tab counts change by one on each deactivate, reactivate, create and delete
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop creates, switches off, switches on and deletes terms, and you watch the tab counts.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 45 is active.
  • Before you start, the Active tab's count reads {Count-A} and the Inactive tab's {Count-B} (write them down).
    For example: {Count-A} is 12 and {Count-B} is 0.
  • A name {Term-A} that no term has.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-24 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  6. Click "Deactivate".
  7. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  8. Click "Deactivate".
  9. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  10. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  11. Click "Reactivate".
  12. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  13. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  14. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the field shows {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows.
  • Step 4: Active reads {Count-A} + 1 (for example 13) and Inactive {Count-B}.
  • Step 5: the menu opens.
  • Step 6: Active reads {Count-A} (back to the starting number) and Inactive {Count-B} + 1.
  • Step 7: the menu opens.
  • Step 8: Active {Count-A} − 1, Inactive {Count-B} + 2.
  • Step 9: Net 45 and {Term-A} are among its rows.
  • Step 10: the menu opens.
  • Step 11: Active {Count-A}, Inactive {Count-B} + 1.
  • Step 12: the menu opens.
  • Step 13: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 14: Active {Count-A} and Inactive {Count-B}: both counts are back where they started (for example 12 and 0).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”
  • S2-R7: “"Deactivate" acts at once, without a confirmation: the term moves to the Inactive tab, both tab counts update, and a success toast shows "{name} deactivated". Every customer and vendor on the term keeps it (Story 5: New Customer and Edit Customer, Story 6: Vendors).”
  • S2-R8: “"Reactivate" acts at once: the term moves back to the Active tab, the counts update, it appears in the customer and vendor pickers again, and a success toast shows "{name} reactivated".”
  • S2-R9: “"Delete Credit Term" opens a confirmation titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Delete Credit Term". On confirm the term is removed from the page and a success toast shows "{name} deleted".”
  • S3-R7: “On Create, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} created", and the term appears on the Active tab in its S1-R5 position, with 0 customers and 0 vendors, available at once in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
